sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球跨境基金设立第一大国、超大型跨国投资架构

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Off-Price Wholesale Liquidation of Branded Overstock Apparel

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (TFEU)
Belgium-Luxembourg Economic Union (BLEU) – China Agreement for the Reciprocal Promotion and Protection of Investments (1986)
Convention for the Avoidance of Double Taxation between Luxembourg and the United States of America (1996, as amended by the 2009 Protocol)
OECD Multilateral Convention to Implement Tax Treaty Related Measures to Prevent Base Erosion and Profit Shifting (MLI)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law of 12 November 2004 on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing, as amended (including Laws of 18 December 2015, 17 March 2016, 23 January 2017 and 17 July 2020); Law of 13 January 2019 establishing the Register of Beneficial Owners, as amended by the Law of 25 March 2020; Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended (governing the SCSp).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport of each general partner, limited partner, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or competent public authority in the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille, or Consular Legalization if from a non-Hague Convention state

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incumbency and good standing of the corporate general partner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or equivalent competent authority in the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter proving source of funds and commercial substance of shareholders
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed bank in the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or banker's certified signature

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified French translation of the partnership agreement and all foreign-language supporting documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Sworn translator admitted before the Luxembourg courts

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of all ultimate beneficial owners, directors, and general partners against the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, EU consolidated financial sanctions lists, Luxembourg Financial Sector Supervisory Commission (CSSF) and Ministry of Finance designations, and, for USD-denominated transactions, the Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons (SDN) list. Politically exposed persons (PEPs) and their family members and close associates must be identified and subject to enhanced due diligence under the Luxembourg AML Law of 12 November 2004, consistent with FATF Recommendation 12 and the Directive (EU) 2018/843, with a three-tier risk classification accepted for this low-risk apparel liquidation trading activity.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) (www.lbr.lu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All RCS filings and the company name must be submitted in French, German, or English; if a name uses characters outside the Latin alphabet, a Latin-script transliteration is mandatory. The legal form 'SCSp' must be appended or indicated in the corporate name. No term implying public or regulated status may be used.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within three months of a formal refusal by the RCS Registrar, an administrative appeal may be brought before the Luxembourg Tribunal Administratif. The appeal must be filed by a Luxembourg-qualified lawyer and addressed to the Director of the Luxembourg Business Registers, stating the grounds of contestation and the requested reservation. Where the refusal is based solely on a conflicting existing name, the applicant may file a new name reservation without an appeal, or petition the court for cancellation of the conflicting registration. A name reservation may be extended by filing a renewal request before the expiry of the initial 90-day period, for a further 90 days, subject to payment of the applicable renewal fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A SCSp must have a registered office in Luxembourg, but that office may be established at the address of the general partner or, with prior approval, at the offices of a regulated domiciliation agent without requiring a physical staff presence on-site. For the stated off-price apparel liquidation wholesale activity, a virtual office is generally permissible, provided the SCSp retains sufficient economic substance and central management and control in Luxembourg to support its tax residence status and avoid being characterized as a foreign permanent establishment.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low risk. The RCS and the Luxembourg tax authority (Administration des Contributions Directes) may carry out unannounced on-site inspections on a risk-based basis; for a low-risk, non-licensed commercial trading entity, the estimated annual probability of an unannounced physical inspection within the first three years is below 5%, absent a filing irregularity, an AML/CFT alert, or significant cross-border transaction triggers.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per translated page, approximately EUR 20–30 per 100 words

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Luxembourg Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended (Chapter II, Section II-bis on the Société en Commandite Spéciale, introduced by the Law of 12 July 2013); Law of 19 December 2002 on the Register of Commerce and Companies (RCS); Grand-Ducal Regulation of 27 April 2016 on the RCS e-filing
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) — Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), Legal Entity Registration Department
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Partnership Agreement / Constitutive Act (Contrat de Société) filed electronically with the RCS and published in the Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (RESA)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum share capital is imposed on the SCSp; the paid-up contribution may be zero or nominal, made in cash or in kind, and no escrow or blocked account obligation exists. Contribution and drawdown terms are freely determined in the partnership agreement.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: We, the undersigned partners of [Name] Société en Commandite Spéciale, hereby resolve: (i) that the mandate and contributed partnership interests subscribed under the partnership agreement dated [Date] are accepted in full and shall be recorded in the partners' register; (ii) the registered office of the SCSp is established at [street, city, Grand Duchy of Luxembourg]; (iii) [Name, surname], residing in Luxembourg, is appointed as general partner and gérant, holding full management powers under the partnership agreement; (iv) the gérant is authorized to complete all RCS filings, tax registrations, and bank account formalities. This resolution is effective immediately. Adopted within the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of the SCSp Partnership Agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg notary (for authentic act) or certified private deed; e-Deposit supported through the Luxembourg Business Registers portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the constitutive contract containing the limited partner list, the powers of the general partner (gérant), registered office address, contribution levels, and profit-sharing rules. Execute the deed either before a Luxembourg notary or by private signature with certified true signatures of all partners. All partners must submit AML/KYC documentation to the general partner prior to countersignature.
required_dossiers: Full legal names, nationalities, and addresses of general and limited partners
Draft partnership agreement (constitutive contract)
Certified identity documents and AML/KYC pack for each partner
Proof of registered office address availability
Statutory declaration of non-bankruptcy of the general partner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or the LBR queries the governance provisions, amend the partnership agreement by addendum and re-execute the deed; any missing KYC documentation must be cured within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS Registration and Issuance of Registration Excerpt
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) — RCS Electronic Filing Window (e-RCS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the electronic application for RCS registration of the SCSp via the LBR online portal, attaching the certified constitutive document, registered office details, and the appointment of the gérant. Pay the RCS filing fee of EUR 75 by direct debit or wire transfer. The RCS verifies the constitutive act and issues the official registration excerpt.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the constitutive act or notarial deed
Standard LBR application form for RCS inscription
Proof of RCS filing fee payment
List of partners and contributed partnership interests
Consent of the registered-office owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS raises an objection, correct the identified inconsistency online within 15 working days and resubmit the amended disclosure; the partnership acquires legal existence on the date of filing, but third-party enforceability remains suspended until publication.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Publication in the Electronic Collection (RESA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers — Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (RESA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon successful RCS registration, the LBR automatically transmits the registration excerpt and the constitutive act to RESA for mandatory publication. Verify the published exegesis, obtain the certificate of publication, and confirm that the SCSp now benefits from full opposability vis-à-vis third parties.
required_dossiers: RCS registration excerpt
Constitutive act as filed
Appointment details of the general partner and gérant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If RESA publication is delayed or contains an entry anomaly, file a rectification request with the LBR and obtain a corrected excerpt; a corrected certificate of publication is generally issued within three working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Opening and VAT / Direct Tax Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg bank of choice; Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AED); Administration des contributions directes (ACD)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the operating and collection bank accounts in the name of the SCSp after completion of the full KYC package. Lodge the VAT registration application (Form 12) with the AED and the initial tax dossier with the ACD; confirm the tax transparency treatment of the SCSp and obtain the Luxembourg VAT number where taxable transactions exceed the threshold.
required_dossiers: RCS certificate of registration
RESA publication certificate
Original partnership agreement and partner KYC documents
Certified identity documents and address proof of the gérant
Bank signatory list and specimen signatures
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank or the AED requests additional clarifications, supply certified English or French translations; if the AED challenges the VAT effective date, file an administrative objection within three months and hold the relevant transactions in suspense pending resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Economic Substance and Administrative Compliance Declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Tax Administration (ACD); Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the annual substance documentation evidencing the real activity of the SCSp, including minutes of partner meetings, registered-office attendance, and records of the gérant's management decisions. Confirm eligibility under the pass-through taxation model and file any required ATAD substance return with the ACD.
required_dossiers: Annual report of the general partner on SCSp activities
Amended partnership agreement if partner admissions occurred
Substance questionnaire completed for the Luxembourg tax authorities
Bank statements and transactional evidence of the commercial activity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a substance audit is opened, submit a corrective action plan demonstrating the actual use of the registered office and the gérant's managerial activity within 30 days of the notification.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial licensing board applies; the Ministry of the Economy (Ministère de l'Économie) retains general sectoral supervision, while off-price wholesale apparel trading is a free activity under the Luxembourg Commercial Code requiring only ordinary merchant registration.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — wholesale apparel liquidation (ISIC 4641 / NAICS 424320) is not a licensed activity in Luxembourg; standard merchant registration with the RCS and tax registrations are the sole mandatory formalities.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Administration de l'environnement — Luxembourg Environment Agency (Ministry of Environment, Climate and Biodiversity)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C — Exempt / Registration-only: the warehousing of finished garments does not constitute an EU industrial emissions listed installation; only the storage of textile rejects exceeding 20 tonnes as non-hazardous waste requires a general waste registration declaration.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or VOC emission points are anticipated in a clothing liquidation warehouse; unsold or defective garments baled for recycling must comply with EU Waste Framework Directive 2008/98/EC and Luxembourg transpose regulations (PCB/TMBR); sanitary and stormwater discharges must respect municipal sewer thresholds, generally not exceeding 25 mg/l BOD5 and 35 mg/l suspended solids.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Administration de la sécurité et de la santé au travail (ASTA) and the communal fire brigade for the warehousing premises; structural load inspection of storage racking systems under EN 15512; workplace clearance including ergonomic and health-and-safety sign-off for sorting and handling personnel.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL), acting within the European System of Central Banks and under the authority of the European Central Bank (ECB); day-to-day foreign exchange and AML supervision delegated to the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro (EUR) is fully convertible in both current and capital account transactions. Luxembourg imposes no exchange controls, no prior approval requirements for profit repatriation, and no restrictions on capital movements within the EU/EEA framework. For an SCSp (Société en Commandite Spéciale), distributions to partners are freely permitted if they comply with the partnership agreement’s cash-flow waterfall and Luxembourg’s statutory rules on limited partnership liabilities, including creditor protection in respect of the general partner. No convertibility hurdles are assessed for the ordinary import and resale of textiles (ISIC 4641).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender requirement exists. EUR-denominated proceeds from trade activities may be retained abroad or in a Luxembourg account without mandated conversion into EUR. There is no minimum holding period, no percentage conversion quota, and no obligation to declare export proceeds beyond standard statistical reporting to the Banque centrale du Luxembourg for balance-of-payment purposes when the transaction exceeds EUR 12,500, subject to the CSSF’s record-keeping obligations.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banque et Caisse d'Épargne de l'État (BCEE)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (multi-currency current account with cash pooling) and Project Escrow Account for liquidation proceeds
Operational Account with SWIFT MT103/MT202 interface and Trade Finance Account for domestic guarantees
Cross-Border Operations Account combined with supply-chain finance (factoring, purchase-order settlement) for apparel liquidation
Multi-currency clearing account for USD/EUR/GBP settlement and inward/outward wires
Capital Escrow Account dedicated to partner contributions and final liquidation distributions

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium – Luxembourg licensed Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs) and Payment Institutions (PIs) are permissible for holding the SCSp’s short-term float and for SEPA/instant credit transfers. Legal constraints: EMIs/PIs cannot offer interest-bearing deposit accounts, cannot perform any lending or investment activity, and must route foreign-currency or high-value wire settlements through a correspondent bank that enforces beneficial-ownership transparency. SCSp accounts can be opened with CSSF-regulated fintech operators, but cross-border garment trade flows (especially from non-EU buyers) may be rejected by the fintech’s internal risk policy unless the SCSp provides a clean three-years trade history and a receipt of its anti-money-laundering profile.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is generally permitted under Luxembourg AML/CFT rules via video identification (eIDAS-compliant) and digital signature. For an SCSp whose general partner (associé gérant) is a corporate entity in an EU/EEA jurisdiction, no physical appearance is required. However, if any ultimate beneficial owner (>25%) is based in a FATF non-compliant jurisdiction, or if the SCSp has a foundation or trust as limited partner, both the general partner’s authorised signatory and the relevant UBO must complete a face-to-face interview, either at the bank’s Luxembourg office or with a qualified notary/financial services professional outside Luxembourg. The bank may also require physical attendance for the initial evidence of authority if the SCSp deed contains unusual liquidation-distribution mechanisms.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: SCSp is not a separate legal personality; the bank cannot independently verify the contract capacity and ongoing liability of its partners.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a certified true copy of the SCSp private partnership agreement, the RCS extract (BusinessNo) issued by the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register, a legal opinion confirming that the general partner has authority to open and operate the account, and an up-to-date extract of the register of partners (even if confidential) showing each partner’s percentage interest.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) is an offshore entity or a foreign trust that might obscure funds provenance from the liquidation of branded overstock apparel (potentially deemed as 'trade-based money laundering' if invoices are weak).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: File the Luxembourg RBE registration certificate (within 48 hours), a notarized declaration of source of wealth and source of funds for each UBO, three years of audited financial statements of the SCSp or its principals, and a transaction-level reconciliation of at least ten majority invoices demonstrating genuine purchase and sale of branded finished garments at off-price margins.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk cross-border payment counterparties in jurisdictions with sanctions or weak AML enforcement, particularly if payment will be routed to/from cash concentration accounts of liquidators.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Prepare an institutional sanctions sweep covering EU, OFAC, UN, and CSSF lists for every known counterparty; obtain a bank-confirmed wire mirror for any pre-existing transaction history; and include a Board/General Partner resolution identifying the purpose of the account, the targeted jurisdictions, and a commit to monthly negative-news screening.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ambiguity about the 'liquidation / off-price' business where large discounts to sales price may be used for value adjustment and funnel unwarranted returns to related parties.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a fully executed liquidation agency or master supply agreement, an independently priced appendix evidencing the lower selling price of off-price inventory, an inventory certificate from a licensed warehouse, and an audited reconciliation of gross proceeds less distribution costs, verified by the SCSp’s Luxembourg statutory auditor.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: for capital contributions: SWIFT MT103 or SEPA Credit Transfer with the payment purpose code ‘CAPI’ (capital injection) and reference to the specific capital call notice (R.C.S. number and partnership registration ID). For shareholder loans: use code ‘LOAN’ with a signed intercompany loan agreement, and for trade-finance-related funding use ‘TRAD’ supplemented by the purchase order and inventory listing. Banks will verify matching between the BO/authority identification and the SCSp’s partner registry; all high-value inbound wires are cleared via TARGET2 or correspondent banking under EBA Clearing rules.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: primary: SWIFT MT103 (single) for direct settlements; for time-critical payments, SEPA Instant Credit Transfer; for international trade settlements: commercial letters of credit issued by the SCSp’s bank (advised by trophy banks in the buyer’s jurisdiction and payable with MT400); for receivables monetisation: factoring or forfaiting via the relationship bank, with the SCSp’s invoice discount facility secured by the garment purchase orders. For recurring off-price purchases from multiple suppliers, use a dedicated multi-currency bank account with a cash pool and a scheduled MT103 batch payments file.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX Forwards (deliverable EUR against USD, GBP, and CNY) with tenors up to 12 months, permitted under Luxembourg law without a CESR/FCA restriction for SCSp acting commercially.
FX Swaps (both straight and forward swaps) for balancing the liquidity of trade receivables and payables.
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCIRS) when associated with underlying inventory purchase financing.
Currency options (OTC) as part of a confirmed hedging strategy, with clear counterparty limits to a licensed European bank.

Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) only in exotic currencies that are not fully convertible, executed through a Luxembourg clearing bank under an ISDA, and subject to the SCSp’s internal treasury policy requiring board approval for speculative transactions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Confirmation (Confirmation Annuelle) of company details
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers – RCS (Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days following the anniversary of the RCS registration date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative penalty up to EUR 1,000; repeated non-filing may result in administrative strike-off from the RCS and manager liability.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: UBO Register update/confirmation (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers – RBE (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of any change in beneficial ownership; if unchanged, confirmed through the annual RCS confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or inaccurate filing exposes the entity to administrative fines; intentional non-compliance is criminally sanctioned (up to 5 years imprisonment and/or up to EUR 1,000,000 fine).

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit for a contractual SCSp unless the partnership agreement or creditors require. For Luxembourg entities generally, mandatory appointment of a réviseur d'entreprise applies when the entity exceeds two of the three small-company thresholds: total balance sheet EUR 4.4 million, net turnover EUR 8.8 million, average 50 employees.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP (Law of 19 December 2002, as amended); IFRS-EU for consolidated accounts of listed groups; SCSp may prepare accounts on Lux GAAP where contractually or legally required.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The annual RCS confirmation serves as a check that the RBE disclosure remains accurate; any transfer of partnership interests or change in the natural-person beneficial owner must be filed with the RBE within 30 days. If there is no change, no separate anniversary UBO declaration is required.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,500 - USD 4,500 per year for a Luxembourg domiciliation agent and registered office
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 for exempt SCSp; USD 7,000 - USD 15,000 if an independent audit is required by contract or chosen by partners

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% at SCSp level in the default fiscally-transparent regime; if the SCSp is opted-in or viewed as a taxable corporate entity, the Luxembourg combined headline rate is 24.94% (Luxembourg City basis: 17% CIT + 7% solidarity surcharge + 6.75% municipal business tax).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No apparel-trade-specific tax holiday; available general relief includes a 80% IP Box exemption for qualifying intellectual property (effective rate approx. 5%), an R&D super-deduction, and the participation exemption for qualifying shareholdings, none of which applies to a routine off-price garments liquidation margin.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Déclaration d'impôt sur le revenu des collectivités - Form 100 (CIT return); filed electronically through the Luxembourg direct tax administration portal (ACD backoffice) or MyGuichet.lu. The SCSp itself does not file Form 100 unless it has elected taxable corporate status; in the default transparent mode each Luxembourg-resident partner integrates its distributive share into its own annual CIT or personal income tax return.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing due by 31 May of the calendar year following the tax year-end for entities with a 31 December year-end; extension requests are routinely accepted until 15 September or later upon justified application to the Administration des contributions directes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identification of the taxable person: tax number, RCS registration, legal form, registered office, central treasury contact.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident partners of an SCSp should not identify the partnership as a separate taxpayer for CIT unless a Luxembourg permanent establishment exists; if a PE is present, quote the PE registration and the appointed local tax representative.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reconciliation of the commercial net result: gross proceeds from off-price clothing liquidation, purchases, warehousing, transport, and other deductible expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For non-residents filing a Luxembourg PE return, include only the Luxembourg-sourced allocation of the SCSp's liquidation margin; third-country buy-sell margin is not taxable unless effectively connected to the Luxembourg trade.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add-back of non-deductible expenses: corporate taxes, 50% of representation costs, provision charges not substantiated, and related-party charges that fail the arm's length principle.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Transparent SCSp partners must avoid treating distributions to a foreign general partner as pure debt interest; the ACD will challenge hidden profit distributions and reclassify them as non-deductible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Loss carryforward relief: deduction of confirmed Luxembourg operating losses utilizable under the statutory loss carryforward provisions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only losses actually allocated to a Luxembourg PE may be used; foreign partner-level losses cannot shelter Luxembourg-situs liquidation gain absent a double-taxation agreement allocation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign tax credits and withholding tax claims: imputation of foreign withholding taxes suffered on cross-border receipts.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach valid foreign tax residency certificates (TRCs) and source-country withholding certificates; claims without a duly filed DTA relief form are disallowed.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Administrative late-filing fine of EUR 250 to EUR 5,000 per retarded return; an additional 10% monthly/quarterly surcharge on unpaid assessed tax (10% bump-up on the balance due); repeated non-compliance can trigger an official assessment and criminal aggravation for executives.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 15% standard Luxembourg withholding tax on dividends paid from a taxable resident company to non-resident shareholders; 0% under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive once the parent holds directly at least 10% for 12 months, and under most Luxembourg DTAs at 5% or 0% depending on ownership. For a transparent SCSp, no entity-level dividend WHT is imposed on distributions to partners.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim DTA relief, the non-resident beneficial owner must obtain an official Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from its fiscal domicile, complete the Luxembourg withholding tax relief application before distribution or, if tax was withheld, submit a refund claim to the ACD within the general five-year limitation period; the partnership's commercial substance and the partner's beneficial ownership must be demonstrated.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Luxembourg statutory WHT on both cross-border royalties and debt interest is 0%; treaty practice generally supresses source taxation at 0% unless the payment is recharacterized as a constructive dividend or profit distribution.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Country-by-Country Reporting threshold: EUR 750,000,000 consolidated group revenue triggers mandatory CbC report, Master File and Local File for a Luxembourg MNE group member. In all other cases the ACD may request a complete OECD TP file once related-party transactions in a year exceed EUR 250,000; an SCSp engaged in inventory liquidation must maintain intercompany purchase and sale documentation to defend the arm's length margin.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Luxembourg applies the OECD BEPS and ATAD substance-over-form rules, including the Principal Purpose Test in tax treaties; an SCSp used for apparel liquidation trade must show real local decision-making, inventory control, a local bank account and adequate administration, otherwise the ACD may disregard the structure, deny treaty benefits and recharacterize profit in Luxembourg.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deleting or understating liquidation gains from the off-price sale of finished garments, creating round-trip invoices to dissipate profit, or using a zero-tax shell vehicle without commercial function to receive the margin.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reassessment of hidden profits plus 10% late-payment interest; administrative fine up to EUR 5,000 per false return; criminal penalty up to EUR 25,000 and imprisonment up to five years under the Luxembourg Abgabenordnung for wilful tax evasion.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The managing/general partner of the SCSp is jointly and severally liable for unpaid tax when the evasion was ordered or signed by that person; courts may impose civil restitution, travel bans and personal confiscation orders in egregious cases.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: SCSp has no physical office, no employees, no inventory storage, and no independent purchase or sale negotiation; the entity merely invoices garments between non-resident related parties and books an artificial margin.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of treaty relief and Luxembourg participation exemption; the structure is disregarded as an abusive arrangement under ATAD/PPT; profits are recomputed on a net-worth basis and assessed at 100% of the under-deducted amount; ACD may inform foreign tax authorities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The general partner of an SCSp bears unlimited personal civil liability for partnership debts; directors participating in the shell arrangement face commercial disqualification, and after criminal conviction, travel bans and prison sentences.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Selling branded overstock below cost to an affiliated offshore distributor while the actual wholesale market price received from third-party buyers is much higher; no CUP or resale margin study is prepared for the liquidation channel.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ACD transfer pricing adjustment to an arm's length resale price margin; additional CIT and net-wealth tax at the partner level; an intentional mispricing penalty of 30-50% of the corrected tax may be applied.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Luxembourg secondary adjustment mechanisms allow recovery from the related foreign party if the Luxembourg partner cannot pay; directors who intentionally instruct below-market prices are personally liable for the penal surcharge if the adjustment is linked to their act.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Issuing invoices for off-price garments to shell buyers using non-existent warehouses, making undocumented wire transfers via unapproved payment rails, failing to identify beneficial owners, and refusing to file a suspicious activity report despite clear red flags.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Luxembourg anti-money laundering law: administrative fines up to EUR 1,000,000 per violation for the entity; officers who knowingly participate in money laundering face up to ten years imprisonment and confiscation of the laundered trade proceeds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The designated AML compliance officer and each managing partner are separately liable for the fine when the violation stems from gross negligence; the Luxembourg public prosecutor can request an international travel ban and issue a European Arrest Warrant against the responsible directors.
